notes.title: Patch #10.1
notes.content: Made a few disk size/ram usage optimizations

notes.title: Patch #10
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where stamina regeneration/decrease rate was tied to the framerate and causing it to be inconsistent
[*] Jumping now costs stamina
[*] Fixed an issue where players could see through walls with the camcorder
[*] Fixed camcorder nightvision being too bright
[*] Added more sound cues to the hound
[*] Made hound's footsteps a bit more audible
[*] Improved the mannequins
[*] Improved a lot the gamefeel of the movements, camera shakes are no longer tied to the animations of the player character, there are now custom camera shakes which should make the gamefeel of movements much smoother and responsive. 
Still if you don't like it you can disable it in the settings, suppressing almost every camera shake effects.
[*] Smilers now have a chance to get stunlocked
[*] Quickly blinking your flashlight can now be useful against some entities
[*] Re-added blinding teammates with flashlight
[*] Other small fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #9
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Made the lobby a bit less dark
[*] Fixed a gap which was too small for the player to go through
[*] Fixed a long gap in the ground
[*] Added randomized lights with different color to locate the manila room a bit easier
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could run without moving
[*] Fixed an issue where jumping would regen stamina
[*] Fixed an issue where the final door would open weirdly
[*] Fixed another issue with the final door which caused it to be blocked even when opened and to open when only one plank is broken
[*] Interacting was blocked for 1 second (which could repeat itself) This was pretty annoying and was changed to 1 sec if there was any successful interaction, not repeatable
[*] Fixed an issue where looking in the camera would remove the hud even after closing the camera
[*] Added The Interloper - Don't look at it
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #8.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a new branch for testing upcoming patches
[*] Fixed a crash that occured on the host when in multiplayer
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #8.5
notes.content: Fixed a big issue with joining multiplayer worlds where trying to join a world while being in game wouldn't work and would often cause softlocks, this is now fixed.

notes.title: Patch #8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Reduced max entity count when the game master starts a horde
[*] Gameplay state is now saved, you won't have to wait for 10 15 minutes for something to happen everytime you load your last save anymore
[*] Added settings for window mode and game resolution
[*] Fixed another bug with the flashlight where clients couldn't inflict flashlight damage to entities
[*] Fixed an issue with the save system where saving multiple times would duplicate objects, also fixes the final door planks
[*] Added a button to restart from last save in the pause menu
[*] Fixed an issue which caused some entities to always focus the player no matter what
[*] Fixed an issue with mannequins and large mannequins that caused them to walk when not moving, making constant loud thuds in the distance.
[*] Fixed an issue where blackouts wouldn't be replicated to clients that join the game while in the middle of a blackout
[*] Other small fixes
[/list]

[*] Increased Player capsule radius
[*] Fixed being able to put your head through walls (actually)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the level to be completable even though the final door was locked
[*] Fixed a texture glitch on some windows

[*] Fixed some collision issues in the manila room

[*] Slightly reduced hound's size
[*] Slightly reduced black hound's size
[*] Reduced large mannequin's capsule size
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest is live !
notes.content:
Hey again ! The playtest for the explorer mode is finally live ! If you still haven't requested access, you can do so on the steam store page of the game right now.

For those who already requested access, you should have a notification from steam telling you that you've been invited to the playtest, the playtest build will then be available in your steam library.

[h1]The Purpose of this playtest[/h1]

This is important. The purpose of this playtest is to find as many bugs as possible to fix them before release. There is probably many bugs lurking around aswell as performance issues, crashes ect... Your feedback is incredibly valuable, and is Key to making Seclusion as good as it can be. Of course, the purpose is not only to find bugs but also gather your feedback on the gameplay, visuals, atmosphere ect... so i can know if i did direct the game in a good direction, or not. 

If you like the game, tell me. If you didn't like the game, tell me why and what could be improved.

My main objective for Seclusion is to make a game with a compelling story that is fun and hassle-free for everyone to enjoy at a reasonable price ^^
And to do that, i need your feedback.

[h2]More Infos[/h2]

I made 2 Guides in the Official discord server that you can follow (how to play in multiplayer/the base rules of the explorer mode)

These guides are probably going to be expanded or new ones could be added. Also, If you want to make a guide, you can do it ^^

The explorer mode is meant to be hard and unforgiving aswell as fun and unpredictable. I think it is pretty hard as i wanted it to be, but your feedback will greatly help me balance the difficulty so it doesn't break the fun.

The level 0 featured in the playtest contains 15+ items with diverse functions to play with. It won't be the case for the Early Access version as items will be scattered in different levels.

[h2]Tips[/h2]

Find a flashlight as soon as possible, Save often, don't stay too close the walls.

Thank you for sticking with me and...

[h1]Have Fun ![/h1]
